About Rerol

We give used oil a second life, and industry a fuel it can trust.

Rerol Refinery Private Limited is a Chennai-based oil re-refining company founded in 2024. We collect used oil, re-refine it and supply tested industrial fuels and base oil to factories and lubricant makers.

Visit or request a sample ↗ Call sales

Our story

Built to close the industrial oil loop.

We started Rerol to bring used oil back into a controlled, documented production cycle and give industrial buyers a more dependable source of fuel and base oil.

Why Rerol

A re-refiner, not simply a reseller.

Quality and supply become easier to manage when the source is closer to the customer. Rerol combines collection, re-refining, batch testing and industrial delivery under one team.

  • Every dispatched batch is checked and documented with a Certificate of Analysis.
  • Used oil collection and finished oil supply can be coordinated through one team.
  • Urgent supply support is available around the clock.

How we work

A partner who owns your requirement.

We help plant and procurement teams choose the right product, plan buying around production and respond quickly when the plan changes.

01

Personal accountability

One team follows the requirement from product selection through dispatch and documentation.

02

Direct decisions

You speak with people who can coordinate product, testing and delivery without long approval chains.

03

04

Purpose

Clear principles behind every batch.

Rerol's direction is grounded in circular use, documented quality and practical service for industrial customers.

VISION

Lead through circular practice

To contribute to India's re-refining industry through responsible recovery and reuse of used oil.

MISSION

Turn used oil into useful products

To produce industrial fuel and base oil under controlled conditions with consistent testing.

VALUES

Quality, safety and integrity

Prove quality, handle oil safely, respond honestly and keep the required paperwork visible.
